rules.description: Applicant must be 70 years of age or above, as recorded in Aadhaar. This is stated in the official parliamentary reply as the SOLE eligibility criterion for this scheme.
rules.user_friendly_explanation: You (or the senior citizen you're checking for) must be 70 years old or older, and the age on record must match Aadhaar.
rules.fail_message: This specific scheme (the free 70+ health cover) is not available - the age requirement of 70 years is not met. You may still be eligible for core PM-JAY or another scheme.
rules.unknown_message: Age was not provided - we can't check this rule without it.

rules.description: Aadhaar-based e-KYC is mandatory for enrolment and issuance of the Ayushman Vay Vandana card.
rules.user_friendly_explanation: You'll need to complete a quick Aadhaar-based identity verification (e-KYC) to actually get the card - this can't be skipped.
rules.pass_message: Aadhaar e-KYC is complete or can be completed as part of enrolment.
rules.fail_message: Aadhaar e-KYC has not been completed - this is required before a card can be issued, though it can be done during the application process.
rules.unknown_message: We don't know if Aadhaar e-KYC has been done - it can be completed during enrolment regardless.

rules.description: If the senior citizen already holds coverage under CGHS, ECHS, or Ayushman CAPF, they must make a ONE-TIME CHOICE between that existing scheme and AB-PMJAY (Vay Vandana) - they cannot hold both simultaneously. This is a choice condition, not a blanket exclusion.
rules.user_friendly_explanation: If you already have CGHS, ECHS, or CAPF health coverage, you'll need to pick one - either keep what you have, or switch to this new senior-citizen cover. You can't use both at once.
rules.pass_message: No conflicting government scheme reported, or the one-time choice has already been made in favour of this scheme.
rules.fail_message: Not applicable - this is a choice condition, not a fail condition.
rules.unknown_message: We don't know if you hold CGHS/ECHS/CAPF coverage. If you do, you'll be asked to choose between that and this scheme during enrolment.

rules.description: Holding active private health insurance or Employees' State Insurance (ESI) coverage does NOT disqualify a senior citizen from also availing AB-PMJAY (Vay Vandana) benefits.
rules.user_friendly_explanation: Having a private health insurance policy or ESI coverage does not stop you from also getting this free government cover.
rules.pass_message: Existing private insurance/ESI coverage does not block eligibility for this scheme.
rules.fail_message: Not applicable - this condition cannot fail.
